entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [dotnet-watch] Possible race condition in GetAggregateCapabilities() #55888
    Backlog
  • Static web assets discovery only sees wwwroot content present at project evaluation time, not files written by a BeforeBuild/Build-hooked target #55883

Closed

  • RewriteCssTest fails locally: Microsoft.Css.Parser is missing from the test project's deps.json #55885
  • [NETSDKE2E]The runtime in September Update .NET SDK 6.0.438 should be 6.0.46 rather than 6.0.45 #55884

PullRequests

Created

  • Remove legacy formatter serialization from custom exceptions #55889
  • [release/11.0.1xx-rc1] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55887
  • dotnetup: Update documentation for access modes and add everywhere mode considerations #55882

Merged

  • Update VersionFeature 8/9/10 for the next release #55846
    Area-Infrastructure, 11.0-rc1
  • Declare Microsoft.Css.Parser in the static web assets test project #55886
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Treat typed task diagnostics as suggestions #55864
    backport, 11.0-rc2
  • Enhance comments for path validation logic #55881

Updated

  • Skip full Build for AOT publish, use Compile instead #54515
    breaking-change
  • Add net12 known framework references #55880
  • Guard synced PowerShell profiles against missing dotnetup #55794
  • Avoid invoking sn.exe during non-Windows signing #55856
    Servicing-consider, Branch Lockdown
  • Consolidate local test execution #55787
    Area-AIEngineering
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0.1xx' => 'main' #55878
    11.0-rc2
  • File-level directives: allow quoting and additional properties #55592
    Area-run-file
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55754
